usedFor: Lancepilot sends template messages through your Lancepilot account, using “Send Template Message” with a phone number.

bestTemplate.name: “Send Template Message” in Lancepilot
bestTemplate.why: It sends a template message to a phone number, so one event can start a standard message.

watchOut: A message to a customer reaches someone outside, so each send waits in Needs you for your approval.
